_meta.description: Tenders and contract packages for the Thane Integral Ring Metro. Values in crore INR. 'tender_status' is floated, bids_opened, awarded, cancelled or unknown. MahaMetro lists its notices on the Thane Metro website (Tenders page: active, under progress and awarded), read 2026-11-03; those are verified. The viaduct award and the bidders come from trade press and posts on X.

tenders.scope: Elevated viaduct, 20.527 km from the end of the underground ramp to Balkum Naka, with the depot approach and three special spans
tenders.notes: Letter of acceptance 10 Dec 2025, from the contractors' stock exchange filings as reported; HG Infra 40%, Kalpataru 60%. Estimate Rs 1,424 crore (NBMCW). Six firms bid (Construction World). The tender is not on MahaMetro's Thane Metro page.

tenders.scope: Construction of six elevated stations: Manpada, Dongripada, Vijay Nagari, Waghbil, Waterfront and Patlipada
tenders.notes: One bid, from BBG Infrastructure, as reported (Construction World, Metro Rail News); no award found. Bids were due 1 Apr 2026 on MahaMetro's list.

tenders.scope: Detailed design of six elevated stations: Dr. Kashinath Ghanekar Natyagruha, Manpada, Dongripada, Vijay Nagari, Waghbil and Waterfront
tenders.notes: Reported as finalised; the consultant is not named in the sources read.

tenders.scope: Detailed design of the two underground stations, Thane Junction and New Thane: architecture, tunnel ventilation, environmental control, building management, E&M (about 3.0 km with ramps)
tenders.notes: Bids were due 15 Apr 2026. MahaMetro invited bids again for the same work in Aug 2026 (T1-038/DDC-06/2026); no award or cancellation notice was read.

tenders.scope: Detailed design and proof checking of the two underground stations, Thane Junction and New Thane, and the tunnel (about 3.0 km with ramps)
Detailed design of six elevated stations: Raila Devi, Wagle Circle, Lokmanya Nagar Bus Depot, Shivai Nagar, Neelkanth Terminal and Gandhi Nagar
tenders.notes: Two bidders for the design of the twelve or thirteen elevated stations in DDC-04 and DDC-05, STUP Consultants and SYSTRA MVA, as reported on X (1 Jul 2026).

tenders.scope: Detailed design of seven elevated stations: Azad Nagar Bus Stop, Manorama Nagar, Kolshet Industrial Area, Balkum Naka, Balkum Pada, Rabodi and Shivaji Chowk
tenders.notes: See DDC-04 for the bidders, as reported.
Excluding GST. The award month is from the news list on MahaMetro's Thane Metro website.

tenders.scope: Transit oriented development plan, local area master plan and multi-modal integration plan
tenders.notes: An earlier round, T1PD-01/2025 (3 Nov 2025), is also on MahaMetro's list.

tenders.scope: Consultant to review the driverless (UTO) trains and systems, shared with Pune Metro Line 4
tenders.notes: Invited again on 12 Feb 2026 (design review and interface validation).

tenders.scope: Shifting and raising high-voltage power lines that cross the route: near Patlipada flyover (ch. 11,350 m), near Waghbil and the Kasarvadavali depot (ch. 14,050 m), between Balkum Naka and Balkum Pada (ch. 20,950 m), and others
tenders.notes: Three notices: 2025, 3 Nov 2025 and 23 Jul 2026. The chainages are MahaMetro's own and count from a different start than this site's distances.

tenders.scope: Public relations agency for the project
